hooks.name: Remind to Update projexplain.md
hooks.description: After each spec task completes, updates projexplain.md with explanation of what was just built

action.prompt: A development task just completed. Check projexplain.md at /home/byte/Desktop/projX/projexplain.md and update it if any new stages were completed in this session. Add a new section under "Stages Completed" for any newly finished stage, explain what was built in plain beginner-friendly English, update the Progress table, and update the "Last updated" line at the bottom. Only add content for stages that are actually done — do not add placeholders.
